ConnectionStrings._comment: Real value lives in dotnet user-secrets (dev) or env vars (prod). NEVER commit a connection string here.

Auth0._comment: Tenant identifier (Domain) and API audience for JWT validation. Both values are PUBLIC — no secret here. Local dev sets them via dotnet user-secrets; cloud dev injects via env vars (Auth0__Domain, Auth0__Audience). Empty defaults make AddPlatformAuth() skip wiring; the API runs unauthenticated.

Auth._comment: Platform-owner allowlist: comma-separated emails. Any matched user is granted PlatformAdmin on every request via PlatformOwnerClaimsTransformer. Set on the Container App as env var Auth__PlatformOwnerEmails (e.g. 'owner@example.com,cofounder@example.com'). Empty = no override.

Groq._comment: AI copilot via Groq's OpenAI-compatible API. ApiKey is a SECRET — set it through env var Groq__ApiKey (Container App secret), never committed. Empty ApiKey keeps the deterministic stub copilot. Model is optional (defaults to llama-3.3-70b-versatile).
